title: Support criterion for a monomial-generated ideal
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $P$ a commutative monoid, written additively. Write $R[P]$ for the free $R$-module on basis symbols $e^p$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module], with the ring structure given on finite formal sums $f=\sum_{p\in P}c_pe^p$, with $e^pe^q=e^{p+q}$, and put $\operatorname{supp}(f)=\{p:c_p\ne0\}$. For any subset $S\subseteq P$, let $J_S=(e^s:s\in S)$ be the ring ideal consisting of finite sums of ring multiples of those monomials. Then
$$f\in J_S\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\forall p\in\operatorname{supp}(f),\ \exists s\in S,\ \exists q\in P,\ p=q+s.$$
No finiteness, cancellation or nontriviality assumption on $P$ or $R$ is required.
